div.head: Af 19.3
div.ab: Gif sweordhwita oðres monnes wæpn to feormunge onfó, oððe smið monnes andweorc, hie hit gesund begen agifan, swa hit hwæðer hiora ǽr onfenge, buton hiora hwæðer ǽr þingode, þæt he hit angylde healdan ne ðorfte.

If a sword-polisher takes another person’s weapon to [re]furbish, or a smith someone’s tool, they must both give it back unhurt just as they received it earlier, unless the two of them earlier agreed, that he [the craftsman] might not be held [liable] for compensation for it.

If a sword-furbisher receives a weapon or smith receives a tool belonging to another man in order to refurbish it, in either case the article shall be returned in as good condition as that in which it has been received, unless it has been stipulated that there shall be no liability on the part of the said furbisher for damage done to it.

Gif sweordhwita oþres monnes wæpn to feormunge onfó, oððe smið monnes ondweorc, hy hit gesund begen agifen, swa hit heora hwæðer ær onfenge, buton heora hweðer ær ðingode, þæt he hit angylde healdan ne þorfte.
